findings.source_quote: “Blessed is that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the two clauses distinctly, for example: “Welgeluksalig is die man wat die HERE sy vertroue maak, wat nie hoogmoediges ag nie en hom nie wend tot dié wat leuens navolg nie.”
